company.name: CYNGN
company.shortDescription: Cyngn specializes in creating and implementing scalable autonomous vehicle technology tailored for industrial entities.
company.description: Cyngn's autonomous vehicle software integrates with a suite of commercially available sensors and hardware to deliver safe, scalable, and efficient self-driving vehicle solutions to industrial organizations. The company's solution is vehicle agnostic, which means heterogeneous fleets can tap into autonomy, switching easily between fully-autonomous, remotely-controlled, and manual modes. Cyngn tackles pressing issues confronted by industrial organizations in the present, including shortages in labor, expensive safety incidents, and growing consumer demands for eCommerce.

aiResearchSummary.text: Cyngn is researching autonomous driving systems for industrial vehicles. Work such as High-definition mapping aligns asynchronous multimodal inputs, while Modular sensor system for automated guided vehicles defines configurable sensor rail assemblies. System and method titles cover off-board-centric computation, adaptive object-based decision making, multi-channel fusion perception, motion compensation, real-time vehicle system identification, and three-dimensional object detection, together addressing perception, decision, and control layers.
